caption: The drawing features a depiction of a rough, irregularly-shaped piece of dark red or maroon fabric with uneven and frayed edges, bordered with a decorative stitching in yellow and green tones. At the center of the fabric are two owls, side by side, both rendered in shades of gray and detailed with fine linework. The owls are perched on a brown branch that stretches horizontally across the composition. There is cursive text in various thread-like colors along the lower part of the fabric piece, with the name "Elizabeth M. Bleak" embroidered—“Elizabeth” in blue, the initial “M.” in light blue, and “Bleak” in yellowish-gold. Additional line decorations and small starburst shapes in yellow and green are distributed across the background of the fabric. The entire fabric patch is drawn against a plain off-white background, and a faint rectangular outline encloses the drawing. The words and numbers “Age 7” are also present, embroidered in a yellowish color, in the upper right part of the fabric.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
